claims: The Artemis II mission reaches top speeds of approximately 25,000 mph (40,000 km/h) upon reentry into Earth's atmosphere.
The SLS rocket travels over 17,000 mph to reach orbit.
The Artemis II mission reaches a max distance roughly 4,700 miles beyond the far side of the Moon.
Initial Orbital Injection speed is approximately 17,500 miles per hour (around 4.9 miles per second) to reach Earth orbit.
The Orion capsule hits the atmosphere at over 25,000 mph (approx. 7 miles per second) to return to Earth.
The Orion capsule endures temperatures nearing 5,000°F during its return to Earth.
